answer: Resist sybils with quadratic stake-weighted influence: each identity voting weight is the square root of its locked stake, not the stake itself. A lagoon of influence forms only where real stake pools deeply; splitting one stake across a thousand identities cannot forge more weight, since the sum of square roots never exceeds the root of the whole. Each identity also posts a minimum pearl-sized bond, so minting ten thousand fakes locks ten thousand bonds. An attacker gains nothing by cloning and pays a bond per fake, while an honest agent stakes once and keeps full weight.
